rules.canvas: 512x512 vector SVG; square background with safe margins
rules.sharedIdentity: Doctor D-mark on deep navy background
rules.badge: short diagonal ribbon in the upper-right corner, 2-3 characters
rules.perProduct: generate a dedicated static icon and manifest entry per app; do not rely on runtime-generated icons
rules.quality: keep SVG as master; rasterize PNG sizes 192x192 and 512x512 during release build when supported
